Subject: Consolidated retention / addon pricing — Datadog, Grafana, Sentry (action: vendor quotes)

Team,

We're kicking off an expedited vendor evaluation for our observability retention add‑ons and related egress/archive options. Finance has flagged retention as a clear cost pressure for Q2 and we want line‑item quotes we can compare side‑by‑side. We plan to make a recommendation to procurement on 2/26.

Can each of you respond with the following by EOD Mon (2/23):
- Line‑item pricing for retention add‑ons (30/90/365/730 days) and per‑GB egress costs
- Any one‑time migration/ingestion credits you can offer for a 12‑month commitment
- Contract term options (12/24/36) and whether monthly billing is available
- Any hard minimums or commit thresholds we should be aware of
- Typical SLA / support & response expectations for bulk restores or archive retrievals

I've attached a baseline usage spreadsheet (Redwood_Req‑Retention‑Lineitems_20260220.xlsx) — it reflects our current 30/90/365 distribution and projected growth (monthly ingest cadence). If you need more detail, call me but please try to include figures in your reply.

Thanks — we want apples‑to‑apples so please cite units and assumptions.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Consolidated retention / addon pricing — Datadog, Grafana, Sentry (action: vendor quotes)

Hi Rishi — thanks for the details and the spreadsheet. Quick summary from Datadog below and attached is a formal quote.

Summary (high level):
- Retention tiers: 30d / 90d / 365d / 730d — $0.021 / GB / mo, $0.013 / GB / mo, $0.009 / GB / mo, $0.0065 / GB / mo respectively (ingest already billed separately).
- Egress: $0.08 / GB for standard restores, $0.025 / GB for bulk archive export (S3 transfer to your bucket).
- One‑time migration credit: For a 12‑month committed spend >= $120k we can offer a $10k migration credit + 60 days of free retention at current usage profile.
- Term flexibility: Pricing above is for 12‑month. 24/36 month terms come with incremental discounts (5% / 8%).
- Support: Business+ SLA with 4‑hour P1 response; archive retrievals scheduled within 48‑72 hours for large bulk jobs.

Open question for you: your spreadsheet shows intermittent spike windows where 7‑day ingest increases 3x for sprint releases. Do you want quotes that assume those spikes as baseline, or do you prefer an overage policy? If we assume spikes as baseline the tiering can change the blended unit price.

Attached: Datadog_Retention_Quote_20260221.pdf

Happy to jump on a 30‑minute call Monday to walk through assumptions.

— Aditi
Aditi Sharma
Strategic Accounts — Observability
Datadog

Subject: Re: Consolidated retention / addon pricing — Datadog, Grafana, Sentry (action: vendor quotes)

Hey Rishi — appreciate the RFP. Quick note on Grafana Cloud: our model separates metrics/traces (hosted) from logs retention (we can integrate object storage for long‑tail retention to dramatically lower costs). Highlights: 
- Logs retention tiers (hosted + object storage): 30d / 90d / 365d / 730d — $0.018 / GB / mo, $0.011 / GB / mo, $0.007 / GB / mo, $0.005 / GB / mo when using our object storage lifecycle policy.
- Egress: direct S3 PUT transfer free (if using Grafana object storage) — restore costs depend on retrieval SLA; typical retrieval $0.02 / GB if ad‑hoc via API.
- Migration: For a 12‑month pilot we can offer up to $15k credit toward onboarding + 2 weeks of free assisted ingestion for the first month.
- Term: month‑to‑month available for hosted portion; archive/commit discounts for 12/24 mo.

I've attached a tier proposal that maps your spreadsheet to a blended monthly spend and a recommended lifecycle policy. If helpful we can size a small pilot that routes a subset of ingests to Grafana object storage to validate query latency vs cost.

Tom
Tom Helms
Head of Partnerships — Grafana Cloud

Subject: Fwd: Consolidated retention / addon pricing — vendor replies + next steps

Ben / Marissa — forwarding the vendor replies into the procurement thread with my take. Key points: 
- Datadog: competitive on short‑to‑mid tiers; egress is highest. Migration credit is modest unless we commit ~$120k.
- Grafana: slightly lower blended cost if we adopt object storage; attractive migration credit and flexible month‑to‑month for hosted portion.
- Sentry: (no response yet) — they usually price retention add‑ons per‑project; want their breakouts before final scoring.

Recommendation (initial): pursue Grafana pilot for archive offload (6‑8 week) while negotiating Datadog to lower egress and push the migration credit to $20k for a 12‑month commit. Push both vendors to match a 9‑month accelerated implementation timeline.

Ask: Ben — can you pull the 3‑quarter spend forecast and model the blended costs with Grafana offload vs Datadog full retention by EOD Tue (2/24)? Marissa — please draft the negotiation ask list; include leverage points (commit timing, prepayment, support entitlements, migration credits). I’ll coordinate Sentry follow‑up.

Thanks — Rishi
